selection_guidance.geo: Treat US, Canada, and Taiwan as near-equal discovery markets; Taiwan may be only slightly higher, not dominant.
selection_guidance.relevance: Prefer entities/events that matter to US equities, technology supply chains, macro, rates, or major crypto assets. A non-US company is valid if it can materially affect US-listed stocks or investor attention.
selection_guidance.dedupe: One final slot per company/asset/entity. Merge long-tail queries about the same entity.
